title: Mini-sparkline renderer + keyboard-navigable legend + tooltip a11y improvements
creator: Ava Nguyen
description: Goal: Replace the existing time-series mini-chart (sparkline) and legend interactions with an implementation that scales to high-series counts, reduces re-renders, and meets keyboard/assistive-tech requirements. This ticket covers: 1) a dual-render strategy (SVG for small datasets, Canvas with downsampled paths for large datasets), 2) a lightweight keyboard-focusable legend that supports arrow navigation and series toggling, 3) a tooltip aggregation mode for dense charts (show top-N series + summary) and ARIA live updates for dynamic tooltips, 4) shared design tokens for chart color palettes and spacing, and 5) perf budgets (initial render < 40ms for 10 series x 1k points on a typical developer laptop). Acceptance criteria: - Sparkline displays identical visual tokens as full charts and respects theme tokens. - Legend is reachable via keyboard, supports focus ring, space/enter toggles visibility, and announces state changes via aria-live region. - Tooltip has an option to collapse into an aggregated summary when > 6 visible series and is accessible to screen readers. - Large datasets fall back to Canvas renderer automatically at > 5k points per series or when total points > 25k, with smooth hover/interaction. - Unit and visual regression tests added; perf benchmark recorded in dashboard.
